fato_historico: 1941: World War II: The destroyer USS Reuben James is torpedoed by a German U-boat near Iceland, killing more than 100 U.S. Navy sailors. It is the first U.S. Navy vessel sunk by enemy action in WWII.
energia_do_dia: Today, consider how deep currents shape your path. Even in the darkest depths, light finds a way to surface, much like a beacon amidst restless waters. It is a good time to reflect on resilience and honor the strength of those who sailed before you. May your unique Aquarius spirit navigate toward clarity, hope, and new horizons today.
frase_do_dia: Even the deepest waters cannot extinguish the inner light of a wandering soul.
significado_numero: Representing the strength of foundations during unexpected transitions.
conselho: Trust your intuition and keep your vision fixed on a brighter future ahead.
